summary: Module 01 edited into one module. node tools/check.mjs --module 1 --lang en --words reports 0 errors and 1 warning, the expected 'figures not drawn yet'. The session-ref and anchor warnings are gone, and all five labs still MATCH when run with labrun (no code was changed). Concept prose comes to 19,787 words against a plan target of 16,350 (s1 1372, s2 1586, s3 1635, s4 1510, s5 1702, s6 1677, s7 1916, s8 2304, s9 1444, s10 1707, s11 1670, s12 1264); nothing was shortened. 18 of the 27 figures are kept: fig-01-2, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12, 13, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 25, 26 and 27. The plan JSON's display fields are polished, it is still valid JSON, and every activity ref resolves.
changes: Fixed the KaTeX ERROR at 11-concepts-b.md:993. A wrapped line began with '- \bar f]', which Markdown read as a list item and which broke the dollar pairing; the expression is now on one line.
Fixed the stray backtick in the polynomial-capacity widget body ('$N = 200`' became '$N = 200$') and a literal tab in Lab 1 step 7 ('$3<TAB>imes10^{-6}$' became '$3\times10^{-6}$').

One symbol per quantity. Section 5's proof of E[RSS] = (N - p)sigma^2 and Section 8's tr(...)/N now use the hat matrix P, as Section 2 defines it, not H, which this module keeps for the Hessian; a sentence was added giving the two facts the trace step uses. Lab 1's floor formula now uses sigma^2 for the residual variance, since s^2 is the gradient-noise variance of Section 4. Lab 2's ECE formula uses Section 7's freq_b/conf_b notation. In Section 11, PCA's lambda is flagged as an eigenvalue and not the kernel-ridge strength.

Cross-references corrected. Section 9's effective degrees of freedom cited 'Section 8's trace of the hat matrix'; it now cites Section 2. Lab 1 step 1 now points to Section 5 for the N - 4 correction. Lab 3 step 4's 'oddness reason of the last step' now says step 2. Section 4's Module 02 pointer now names Sections 7 (momentum), 8 (Adam) and 9 (range test, schedules). Bare Module links now carry section anchors: M02 s1, s8, s11 and s12, M03 s10, M05 s2, M07 s1 and s10. The Belkin 'After reading' note sent readers to a Lab 3 computation that does not exist; it now points to Section 8's double-descent numbers. Section 8 links the guided reading.

Made the running-example numbers agree with the lab outputs. Section 10 now gives the honest feature-selection score as 0.50 +/- 0.09, as Lab 4 prints (it said 0.10), and says what the +/- is. Section 10's time-series leak is now the pump's casing temperature predicted by a forest, as in Lab 4. Section 12's Monte Carlo SD is now 0.0999, Lab 5's real output, instead of the plan's 0.0995.

Figures: removed nine blocks, leaving 18. fig-01-1 was a decorative pipeline that repeats the five-ingredient table. fig-01-3 repeated the four-point worked example. fig-01-5 repeated fig-01-4 and the widget's factor bars. fig-01-7's numbers are in the outlier worked example. fig-01-10 repeated the weld confusion-matrix example. fig-01-11 repeated Lab 2's ROC/PR plot and worked example. fig-01-14 repeated the bias-variance table. fig-01-17 was a generic CV grid. fig-01-24 was an illustrative k-means/PCA plot. References to removed figures were rewritten: the s3 regimes now point to Figure 1.4, the s5 Laplace bullet gives the peak densities in words, and the s8 CV paragraph drops its figure reference.
Added in-text references to the kept figures that had none: 1.6, 1.12, 1.13, 1.16, 1.19, 1.22, 1.23, 1.25 and 1.27. Labs 2, 4 and 5 now say which concept figure each of their plots corresponds to.

Voice and BRIEF fixes: two question headings became statements ('Checking the fit: residuals and chi^2_nu'; Lab 5 'Step 4: check the quoted uncertainty by simulation'), 'toward' became 'towards', and the Lab 4 and Lab 5 runtime claims now match the measured runs ('well under a minute', 'a few seconds').

Re-ran the Lab 4 selection-bias extension with labpy and confirmed it: 0.67 best and 0.56 nested for seed 0, with 0.70/0.60 and 0.64/0.54 for seeds 1 and 2. Those seed values were added to Lab 4's Try this. Also confirmed Section 7's ECE of 0.023 (5 bins) and 0.039 (10 bins), the mean confidence of 0.956 against an accuracy of 0.986, and Section 9's effective degrees of freedom of 10.4 at lambda = 0.032.
Summary trimmed from 13 to 12 bullets by merging the honest-evaluation and interval bullets, keeping all their content (SPEC allows 8-12).

Plan JSON (plan\module_01.json), display fields only. The lead was tightened to one sentence. Prerequisites and software are one sentence each, with code names in backticks. Outcomes lost the 'By the end you can' prefix and their maths is now in $...$ ($\mathbf{X}$, $\eta < 2/\lambda_{\max}$, $\kappa$, $\lambda = \sigma^2/(N\tau^2)$, $\chi^2_\nu$, $k$-NN). Session titles were kept and each activity's 'what' was rewritten as one sentence. Activity refs were remapped: what_goes_wrong to wrong, paper1/2/3 to reading, review to summary. Session totals are 122, 130, 121, 125 and 130 minutes. A backup of the original is in the scratchpad (module_01.json.bak).
issues: Concept prose is 19,787 words, against the plan's 16,350 and BRIEF's 13,000-17,000. s8 (2,304 against 1,450), s7 (1,916 against 1,450), s4 (1,510 against 1,100) and s5 (1,702 against 1,300) are the largest overruns. With nine figures removed, the page will show Figures 1.2, 1.4, 1.6, 1.8, 1.9, 1.12, 1.13, 1.15, 1.16, 1.18-1.23 and 1.25-1.27, with gaps. The ids were not renumbered because the plan's figure descriptions are keyed by id and only display fields could be edited. Either the build renumbers by order of appearance, or the ids and the plan entries are renumbered together. The plan still lists the nine removed figures; the figure-drawing phase should skip fig-01-1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 11, 14, 17 and 24.

Two kept data figures are not generated by any lab's code, although writer_notes say data figures come from labs. fig-01-15 (learning curves) is only a Lab 3 'Try this' exercise, and fig-01-19 (ridge/lasso paths on load_diabetes) is in no lab. The drawer must compute both from the captions.
Section 10 links the AI Agents series index (../agent/index.html), not a specific module, because that series' evaluation module number is not known.
Lab 4's step 8 summary table prints values copied from steps 2-5 rather than computing them; it still matches its own output.

The guided-reading details were checked against memory, not the web: the Belkin random-Fourier-features figure, the Kapoor and Narayanan taxonomy, civil-war case and model info sheets, and the Domingos dartboard figure and section names. They are consistent with the published papers as far as I know, but a web check before publishing would be prudent.
